account_history_window_check.name: account_history_window_check
account_history_window_check.value:
("account"."history_from" IS NULL OR "account"."history_through" IS NULL OR "account"."history_from" <= "account"."history_through")
      AND ("account"."history_completeness" != 'complete' OR ("account"."history_from" IS NOT NULL AND "account"."history_through" IS NOT NULL))
      AND ("account"."history_completeness" != 'unknown' OR ("account"."history_from" IS NULL AND "account"."history_through" IS NULL))

transaction_booked_precision_check.name: transaction_booked_precision_check
transaction_booked_precision_check.value:
("transaction"."booked_precision" = 'instant' AND "transaction"."booked_on" IS NULL)
      OR ("transaction"."booked_precision" = 'calendar_day' AND "transaction"."booked_on" IS NOT NULL)

transaction_relation_check.name: transaction_relation_check
transaction_relation_check.value:
("transaction"."relation_kind" IS NULL AND "transaction"."related_account_external_id" IS NULL AND "transaction"."related_movement_external_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("transaction"."relation_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "transaction"."related_account_external_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transaction"."related_movement_external_id" IS NOT NULL)

transaction_removal_check.name: transaction_removal_check
transaction_removal_check.value:
("transaction"."removed_at" IS NULL AND "transaction"."removal_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("transaction"."removed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "transaction"."removal_reason" IS NOT NULL)

objective_kind_period_check.name: objective_kind_period_check
objective_kind_period_check.value:
(
        ("objective"."kind" = 'amount_based' AND "objective"."is_recurring" IS NULL AND "objective"."period" IS NULL AND "objective"."start_date" IS NULL AND "objective"."end_date" IS NULL) OR
        ("objective"."kind" = 'time_based' AND "objective"."is_recurring" = true AND "objective"."period" IS NOT NULL AND "objective"."start_date" IS NOT NULL) OR
        ("objective"."kind" = 'time_based' AND "objective"."is_recurring" = false AND "objective"."period" IS NULL AND "objective"."start_date" IS NOT NULL AND "objective"."end_date" IS NOT NULL)
      )

objective_dates_order_check.name: objective_dates_order_check
objective_dates_order_check.value: "objective"."end_date" IS NULL OR "objective"."start_date" IS NULL OR "objective"."end_date" > "objective"."start_date"

income_source_schedule_check.name: income_source_schedule_check
income_source_schedule_check.value: ("income_source"."regularity" = 'regular' AND "income_source"."schedule" IS NOT NULL) OR ("income_source"."regularity" = 'irregular' AND "income_source"."schedule" IS NULL)
